label: Kampar flood

sequence: Continuous heavy rain from the afternoon of 19 December 2023
Sungai Kampar overflows; water enters the ground floor from the rear lane at about 3:00 am on 20 December 2023 and rises to about 1.2 metres
Water stands until the afternoon of 21 December
As the water recedes, the saturated and washed-out ground lets a section of the rear boundary wall lean and partly collapse and the rear driveway settle

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 20 December 2023 falls inside 1 December 2023 to 30 November 2024.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: flood (overflow of Sungai Kampar); the wall collapse and driveway settlement follow from the flood-saturated ground, with no intervening event. Flood is excluded by Condition 6(b) under the base policy; FP504, held, brings it in.

gates.reason: Loss on 20 December 2023; first notice and written claim both on 20 January 2024, day 31 against 15. No written extension on file and none requested before that date. quotes.text: On the happening of any loss or damage the Insured shall forthwith give notice thereof to the Company and shall within 15 days after the loss or damage, or such further time as the Company may in writing allow in that behalf, deliver to the Company:
No claim under this Policy shall be payable unless the terms of this Condition have been complied with.

notwithstanding anything stated to the contrary in Condition No. 6 of the Policy, this insurance extends to cover loss or damage directly caused by fire or otherwise occasioned by or through or in consequence of Flood (including overflow of the sea)

Flood, for the purpose of this extension, shall mean the overflowing or deviation from their normal channels of either natural or artificial water courses, bursting or overflowing of public water mains and any other flow or accumulation of water originating from outside the building insured or containing the property insured, but excluding loss or damage caused by subsidence or landslip.
(c) Loss or damage caused by subsidence or landslip except when this is occasioned by earthquake or volcanic eruption, provided that these perils are insured against by this Policy.
(a) loss or damage to swimming pools, terraces, patios, drives, footpaths, walls, gates or fences unless the building, its outbuildings or garages are damaged by the same cause and at the same time.
(e) Securities, obligations, or documents of any kind, stamps, coins or paper money, cheques, books of account or other business books, or computer systems records.

during the Period of Insurance stated in the Schedule or of any subsequent period in respect of which the Insured shall have paid and the Company shall have accepted the premium required for the renewal of this Policy

must_not_cite.reason: Held, and the flood falls squarely within its definition, but Condition 12 is a condition precedent and defeats it. An assistant that reasons only about perils will approve this claim.
Not engaged. The claimant is the Insured's spouse managing the business; the Insured remains the registered proprietor.

counterfactual.basis: Priced under FP504 but for Condition 12, on the adjuster's assessed loss. Not payable unless the Company allows further time in writing.
steps: Excluded: refs 6 and 7, 12,900.00 (FP504 Special Condition 1(c) and FP510 exclusion (a)); ref 8 cash 6,800.00 (Condition 8(e)).
Remaining refs 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 = 91,050.00; no average (values at risk below sums insured on every item).
Would have paid 88,550.00, labelled not payable.

working: Declined at gate 3. Counterfactual only, for the senior referral: 34,600.00 + 11,200.00 + 9,800.00 + 22,400.00 + 8,900.00 + 4,150.00 = 91,050.00, less FP504 excess 2,500.00 = 88,550.00, not payable.

Items that would fail anyway: refs 6 and 7, 12,900.00. FP504 Special Condition 1(c) excludes subsidence or landslip; FP510 exclusion (a) excludes drives and walls unless the building is damaged by the same cause at the same time, and it was not; the FP510 excess, 5% of total sums insured (21,250.00) or 25,000.00 whichever is lower, exceeds the amount claimed. Ref 8 cash 6,800.00: Condition 8(e), no money item on the schedule.

ambiguity.question: Whether the Company will exercise its discretion to allow further time in writing, given the claimant's reasons (no power or mobile coverage for several days, clean-up, the Insured abroad).
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: The Company may still allow further time in writing. Correct output is a declinature on Condition 12 with the discretion flagged for senior referral, not a silent refusal.
